//! pull request, and the review threads read beside it, are recorded by
//! [`Runner::hear_contributions`] and answer nothing here.
//!
//! The forge is asked with the runner's lock let go:""",1)
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
git add -A && git commit -q -m "feat(contributions): kelpie hears a contributor's comments, review replies and pushes

A contribution is a conversation with someone else, and kelpie heard only
the maintainer. The runner's thread read now serves the followed pull
requests too: one comments_since read per poll, shared with the rulings'
replies, sorted by author and never by the words.

- Forge::thread_replies_since reads a pull request's review-thread
  comments through GraphQL; the gh adapter parses a fixture saved from the
  schema's shape (a worker cannot run gh api to record one).
- A contribution keeps heard and context: the last 50 of the contributor's
  and the maintainer's comments, review replies and pushes, as kind, id and
  time with no text. State version 47.
- A bot, a third party and a comment kelpie posted through gh are not
  heard. A failed review read is read again from where it began.
- Nothing is posted and no reaction is read.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>" && git fetch -q origin && git merge
